sentences.text: THIS MFA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 173(1) OF THE MOTOR VEHICLES ACT, PRAYING TO ENHANCE THE AWARD AMOUNT BY MODIFYING THE IMPUGNED JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 22.09.2022 PASSED BY THE ADDL.
SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC AND MACT AT BIDAR, IN MVC NO.377/2021.

THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ADMISION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS JUSTICE P SREE SUDHA  ORAL JUDGMENT
Though the appeal is listed for admission, with the consent of learned counsel for the parties, it is taken up for final disposal.
2. This appeal is filed against the judgment and award dated 22.09.2022 passed by the Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC and MACT at Bidar, in MVC No.377 of 2021.

3. The claimant met with an accident on 03.08.2020 due to the rash and negligent riding of the rider of the motorcycle bearing registration No.KA-38/ NC: 2025:KHC-K:6684 HC-KAR Q-7374 and sustained grievous injures.

Therefore, he filed a claim petition before the Tribunal, claiming compensation of Rs.8,50,000/-.
4.

The Tribunal, considering the entire evidence on record, granted compensation of Rs.3,53,683/-
with interest at 6% p.a. from the date of petition till realisation and directed respondent No.2-Insurance Company to deposit the same.
Therefore, requested for enhancement of compensation.

6. Heard the arguments of both sides.
7.
In the disability certificate issued under Ex.P14, the Doctor stated that simple wounds are healed and the fracture injury unite slowly after six months of the surgery.
He also stated that, he has taken X-ray and found that, there is a mal union in the right leg right upper third.
Therefore, he assessed the disability at 40%.
The Tribunal has taken the disability at 10% to the whole body.

1/3rd of 40%
comes to 13%.
However, considering the fact that there is mal union, this Court finds it reasonable to take the disability at 15%.
Though the appellant stated that he was doing milk vending business and taking tuition classes and earning Rs.25,000/- per month, he has not produced any income proof.
Therefore, as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority, as the accident is of the year 2020, his notional income is to be taken at Rs.13,750/- per month.
The multiplier of '17' adopted by NC: 2025:KHC-K:6684 HC-KAR the Tribunal is just and proper.

Thus,
the loss of future earnings would be:
Rs.13,750 x 12 x 17 x 15% = 4,20,750/-.
8.
The Tribunal has granted Rs.67,283/- towards medical expenses and the same needs no interference.
9. The appellant was admitted in the hospital for 05 days.

Considering the nature of injuries and period of hospitalisation, this Court finds it reasonable to grant an amount of Rs.75,000/- for pain and suffering, Rs.25,000/- for loss of amenities and Rs.30,000/- for transportation, extra nourishment and attendant charges.
10. The appellant might not have attended any work at least for a period of four months due to the injuries sustained.

Therefore, this Court finds it reasonable to grant an amount of Rs.55,000/-
(Rs.13,750 x 4) for loss of income during laid up period.

11. Hence, the appellant is entitled for the modified compensation under different heads as below:
NC: 2025:KHC-K:6684 HC-KAR Pain and suffering Rs.75,000/-
Medical expenses Rs.67,283/-
Loss of future earnings Rs.4,20,750/-
Loss of income during laid up period Rs.55,000/-
Transportation, extra nourishment, Rs.30,000/-
and attendant charges Loss of amenities Rs.25,000/-
Total Rs.6,73,033/-
Less: awarded by Tribunal Rs.3,53,683/-
Enhancement Rs.3,19,350/-

3 The Insurance Company has already deposited the amount awarded by the Tribunal.
Thus, the appellant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.3,19,350/- with interest at 6% per annum and therefore, the appeal deserves to be allowed in part.

12. In the result, the following order is passed:
 (i) Appeal is allowed in part.
(ii) The appellant/claimant is entitled for the enhanced compensation of Rs.3,19,350/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realisation.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:6684 HC-KAR (iii) Respondent No.2-Insurance Company is directed to deposit the aforesaid compensation amount within one month from the date of this judgment.
(iv) On such deposit, the appellant is permitted to withdraw the entire amount along with interest accrued on it.
